title: isoetes × robusta
intro: Isoetes × robusta, commonly known as Quillwort, is a rare aquatic plant species belonging to the Quillwort family (Isoetaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing due to its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Isoetes × robusta are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. Further research is needed to fully explore the health benefits and therapeutic applications of this unique plant species.
